messages:
maria-partnerops: FYI partner payloads this morning include a bunch of 'sku': 'UNKN-0' rows, several with non-zero usage. looks like their device-side mapper is emitting a fallback sku.
kevin-revops: ugh saw that in staging yesterday. appears during lose-of-connection bounce where device reboots and sends a compact heartbeat -> they fill sku with placeholder.
tom-plat-eng: can you paste an example?
maria-partnerops: here are two lines from the webhook we got (redacted):
```
{
  "customer_id": "acme-123",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-22T09:12:34Z",
  "sku": "UNKN-0",
  "units": 42
}
{
  "customer_id": "beta-co",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-22T09:14:02Z",
  "sku": "UNKN-0",
  "units": 0
}
```
alejandra-sales-eng: some partners report these show up only during firmware upgrades for edge appliances. they panic: will we bill them for UNKN-0?
kevin-revops: current ledger-bridge treats unknown SKUs as billable if units>0. so yes unless we change rules.
tom-plat-eng: propose a short-term mitigation: 1) map UNKN-* -> "partner:unknown" in ingest with a tag source=partner-stub 2) exclude from billing if units=0 3) for units>0, route to a reconciliation queue and hold credits for 24h pending partner confirmation.
sanjay-ml: we can auto-detect stub events by pattern: zero or single-digit units + timestamp within 2 minutes of partner heartbeat flood. could auto-classify with high precision.
partnerbot: webhook delivery: 200 OK to /marketplace/webhook (partner-edge). signature verified.
maria-partnerops: plan sounds good. questions: how will this affect SLA for near-real-time usage dashboards? partner ops needs clarity.
tom-plat-eng: dashboard: show "tentative credits" bucket for those rows; not counted in committed billing until reconciliation completes. no API breaking changes.
alejandra-sales-eng: we should notify partners of new HOLD behavior — add to integration guide and send a short advisory. partners will want a clear TTL and manual override.
kevin-revops: implementation notes: ledger-bridge: add flag hold_for_recon=true, hold_expiry_ts = event_ts + 24h. aggregation: treat hold rows as zero for billing snapshots but include them in exploratory exports.
sanjay-ml: will add a simple probabilistic classifier (rule-based first) and expose confidence score in the export, e.g., confidence=0.95.
maria-partnerops: owners?
tom-plat-eng: eng will ship ingest mapping + hold flag by EOD tomorrow (owner: tom). kevin will update aggregation/ledger-bridge by Friday (owner: kevin-revops). maria will draft partner advisory and update integration docs (owner: maria-partnerops) by Wednesday. alejandra will coordinate comms to top-5 partners impacted.
alejandra-sales-eng: +1 — if partners have historical disputes, offer one-off reconciliation window.
kevin-revops: edge case: some partners intentionally report UNKN when usage is for private SKUs we don't map. for those we need partner-provided override mapping file. add onboarding checklist item: signed sku mapping CSV.
tom-plat-eng: good call — add validation: if partner posts sku mapping file via portal, auto-apply and clear existing holds for matched rows.
partnerbot: cron: scheduled-recon-check triggered 2026-03-23T00:00:00Z.
maria-partnerops: ok i'll coordinate a short tckt template for partners to claim held rows (include original event id + sample payload).
sanjay-ml: I'll push initial classifier rules to the repo and add metrics: false-positive rate target <2% on held rows.
maria-partnerops: thanks team. sync at 11am tomorrow to confirm rollout cadence. :thumbsup:
thread_text_snippet: partner payloads with 'UNKN-0' sku; proposal: hold >0 units for 24h and route to recon queue, auto-classify stubs, notify partners
